description: We are La Candona, an innovative team from Guatemala passionate about technology, science, AI, and space exploration. Our project, MARS SURVIVAL, aims to create an interactive 3D platform using real NASA data to explore Mars, plan routes, and simulate astronaut survival. We welcome creative teammates skilled in programming, AI, astronomy, GIS, 3D modeling, and UI/UX. Join us to innovate, collaborate, and proudly represent Guatemala at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026! 🚀
